This document lists the equipment inspection I1 for 
all valve types, to be performed every two months as indicated by M2 in the 
title block

The first draft initiated by eng. Abdel Naeim 
 Attallah Ahmed, accepted by eng. Gomah Lotfy: general director, revised by 
 EDEPC inspection and quality control eng. Samir Abd El Glil, and approved by 
 eng. Mokhter Abd Elatif: head sector of Ataka Power Station ( 2x300 + 2x150 ) 
 MW.

This 
document accepted by eng. Samir Abd El Gilil EDEPC inspection & quality control 
general director, MPIS coordinator, and 
certified by accountant Mahmoud Soliman EDEPC admin & financial inspection & 
quality control's general director and supervisor of inspection & quality 
control head sector.

items:
A work permit must be issued and the qualified
maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category.

Safety fence with caution marks must 
 be surrounding 
 the work area is required.

Wear the 
 safety 
 and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes, ...etc.

Hearing and eye protection should 
 be used when working on a valve which is under pressure.

Isolate valve 
 mechanically and electrically.

Drain the 
 pipelines, which connected to this valve.
The boiler must be drained, and the boiler vents must be opened.

Never strike a valve 
 which is under pressure. Premature actuation can result.

Never stand in front of the discharge outlet of a pressure relief valve, 
 which is under pressure.
Always approach and use any pressure relief valve with great care.
Complete maintenance tool set.
Suitable lifting device
Cleaning fluid

Check any leakage form valve gland fit found, retighten on gland bolts or 
 renew the gland pocking.

Check any leakage from the pressure tight cover. If it found retighten the 
 cover nut.

Check any leakage if there is any internal leakage it must be carried out the 
 maintenance procedure of this type to prevent the leakage.

Check any leakage from the valve bodies (arracks or mechanical wear) remark 
 the point of leakage and welded it with suitable electrode.
Check the electrical drive of the valve for electrical type.
Check the operation of the valve drive during closing /opening of the valve .
Check the oil level of the gear-motor for electrical drive.
Re-grease the valve spindle.
